database_name: Legal Metrology Packaged Commodities Rule Database

architecture.category_rules: Loaded from the corresponding category JSON

notes: Restructured from a flat per-category database in which 20 common/general Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) rules (LM_PCR_001 to LM_PCR_020) were duplicated verbatim inside every one of the 28 category files.
Those 20 common rules were consolidated into a single canonical copy each in compliance_rules.json and removed from all category files.

Four category-specific rules (LM_LPG_001, LM_FOOD_003, LM_COSM_001, LM_PHARMA_001) had been duplicated across more than one category file in the source database; each was consolidated into its single most appropriate category file (other, food, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals respectively) based on the rule's own 'category' field and requirement text.

19 of the 28 categories (beverages, personal_care, household_cleaning, baby_and_childcare, pet_products, footwear, electrical_appliances, stationery_and_office, toys_and_games, sports_and_fitness, home_and_kitchen, automotive, hardware_and_tools, industrial_products, chemical_products, construction_materials, jewellery_and_accessories, tobacco_and_related_products, unknown) had no category-specific rule identified in the source database beyond the common rules; their files contain an empty rules array with an extraction_notes explanation, per the restructuring spec. The 20 common rules from compliance_rules.json still apply to products in these categories via the Rule Engine.
No rule content, wording, source citations, rule IDs, applies_when/check_type/check_parameters/evidence_required/source/source_text/effective_from/status fields were altered.
